events.verdict: Green (HOU) swiftly rests and removes his hand from Paul's (SAS) shoulder as he dribble towards the sidelines and the contact is marginal.
Green's (HOU) arm lightly brushes the ball and part of Sochan's (SAS) right arm during his contest of the layup attempt and the contact is marginal.
Green (HOU) steps near the sideline as he receives the ball. There is no clear and conclusive angle that shows his foot touch the line.
Sochan (SAS) establishes himself in Green's (HOU) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players engage and disengage during the pick.

Smith Jr. (HOU) moves alongside Castle's (SAS) path and then jumps alongside Castle, raising his right arm up and legally making contact with the ball, which dislodges it from Castle's grasp during the driving shot attempt.
VanVleet (HOU) and Paul (SAS) engage and disengage during the loose ball and the contact is marginal.
Paul (SAS) and Brooks (HOU) make marginal arm to arm contact with one another while in pursuit of the loose ball.
Brooks (HOU) swiftly places and removes his hand from Wembanyama's (SAS) front at the start of his drive and the contact is marginal.

VanVleet (HOU) brings his right hand towards the ball and dislodges it away from Wembanyama (SAS) during his dribble in the post. VanVleet's contact with the ball is simultaneous to incidental hand on ball contact with Wembanyama.

events.verdict: Whitmore (HOU) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to San Antonio.
Smith Jr. (HOU) swiftly grasps and releases the side of Johnson's (SAS) jersey and the contact during the inbound is marginal.
Brooks (HOU) rests and removes his hand from Wembanyama's (SAS) side during the inbound and the contact is marginal.
Smith Jr. (HOU) commits a take foul on Castle (SAS).
Sochan (SAS) legally contests Green's (HOU) driving shot attempt.
Brooks (HOU) briefly rests his arm on Wembanyama's (SAS) side and the marginal contact dissolves shortly thereafter during the inbound.
Green (HOU) commits a take foul on Johnson (SAS).
Sengun (HOU) and Wembanyama (SAS) engage away from the ball and the contact is marginal.
Smith Jr. (HOU) commits a take foul on Castle (SAS).
Sochan (SAS) avoids making illegal contact with Green (HOU) as he ends his drive and gathers the ball.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that shows Sochan (SAS) makes illegal contact with Green (HOU) during his jump shot attempt.
